fields.title: Kōgyō oyobi Gunji Shisetsu Hoshu Shiji no Sai ni kansuru Gyōsei Hōkoku

report.subject: Kobayashi Isamu no uketa mutsunagaru hoshu shiji no fuguai ni kansuru chōsa
report.author: Yamamoto Kenzo

fields.summary: Minkan kōgyō bu to gunji kanri bu no aida de hassei shita hoshu meirei no fuguai ni kansuru gyōsei chōsa hōkoku.
findings: Minsei bu to gunji bu no aida no rensa sokushin ni yori, fukusō shita meirei ga kōsei sareta.
Kobayashi Isamu shi no seikyū wa, fukusō suru meirei no chōsei o motomeru mono de ari datō de aru.
recommendations: Ryōsha no meirei o tōgō shi, shinseisha no seikyū o ukeireru (accept) koto.

claims.fact: Gyōsei hōkoku wa fukusō suru meirei no sonzai o nintei shi seikyū o ukeireru koto o shōmei shite iru.
